# Max Watch

> A 100% offline, free, open-source, encrypted Mac & Windows video recorder with motion detection (`macOS 13.0+` Apple Silicon & Intel, and `Windows 10 / 11` x64 & ARM64).

- Website: https://maxfreedompollard.github.io/Max-Watch/
- Source Code (MIT License): https://github.com/MaxFreedomPollard/Max-Watch
- Latest Release & Installers (macOS DMG / PKG + Windows Setup & Portable EXEs): https://github.com/MaxFreedomPollard/Max-Watch/releases/latest
- Homebrew Install (macOS): `brew tap maxfreedompollard/tap && brew install --cask max-watch`
- Privacy Policy: https://maxfreedompollard.github.io/Max-Watch/privacy.html

## Summary

Max Watch turns any MacBook, iMac, Mac mini, Windows laptop, desktop PC, or external USB webcam into a motion-activated video and audio security recorder that continues recording even while the screen is locked (`Ctrl+Cmd+Q` on Mac or `Win+L` on Windows). All footage is encrypted in memory using `Curve25519` + `PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256` (`310,000` rounds) + `AES-256-GCM` into a password-protected local video vault with zero cloud servers, zero accounts, zero subscriptions, and zero network access.

## Key Capabilities

- **Motion-Activated Webcam & USB Camera Recording**: Continuous sensitivity sliding scale (`10%` heavy motion only up to `100%` subtle movement) with live motion energy meter, trigger threshold line, `48 kHz` AAC microphone `dB` meter, and a one-click **Audio ON / OFF switch** for recording with sound or silent video-only (`1080p` H.264 via Apple VideoToolbox on Mac and Windows Media Foundation on Windows).
- **Unambiguous International Bottom-Left Timestamp**: Burns the user's local computer date and time into the bottom-left of every clip using a spelled-out month and 4-digit year (e.g., `14 Nov 2026 • 21:35:34 GMT`) so dates are never ambiguous internationally.
- **Records While Mac or Windows Screen Is Locked**: Prevents idle system sleep while armed and keeps capturing and encrypting motion clips in the background while the desktop screen is locked.
- **Strictly Locked-While-Saving AES-256 Video Vault**: Public-key capture keeps the vault locked right after password setup, while motion detection is armed, and while saving clips, preventing anyone who enters the room from opening `Play All` or deleting recordings without the password.
- **1-Second Power-Cut-Safe & Exit-Safe Recording**: Encrypts and flushes 1-second fragmented MP4 (`fMP4`) chunks continuously so recordings survive sudden power loss or battery drain, and flushes active clips cleanly on app exit (`Cmd+Q` / `Ctrl+Q`, `SIGTERM`, logout/restart/shutdown).
- **Zero-Plaintext RAM Playback, Fast Scrubber Ball & `1x` / `4x` / `12x` Speeds**: Streams decrypted video segments directly from RAM (`AVAssetResourceLoader` on Mac / `IMFByteStream` on Windows) with zero plaintext temp files on disk. Includes a fast-drag timeline scrubber ball for instant frame skimming plus `1x`, `4x`, and `12x` sequential playback.
- **One-Click `Save & Next` & `Delete & Next`**: Exports standard `.mp4` copies to any user-selected folder outside the vault (`Save & Next`, `Cmd+S` / `Ctrl+S`) or securely zero-wipes unwanted clips from the vault (`Delete & Next`, `Cmd+Delete` / `Ctrl+Delete`) while immediately advancing to the next clip.
- **100% Offline Enforcement**: Signed on macOS without network entitlements (`com.apple.security.network.client` / `server` omitted) and compiled natively on Windows with zero network socket or HTTP DLL imports.
